name: 3D Scene Editing
research_question: How can text-guided editing of 3D Gaussian splatting scenes preserve unedited regions and multi-view consistency?
project_description: Building a text-guided 3D scene editing pipeline on top of 3D Gaussian splatting with diffusion-model guidance.
desired_outcomes: choose a baseline editing method to build on
understand background preservation and multi-view consistency techniques
know the standard evaluation protocols and datasets for 3D editing
constraints: single consumer GPU (24 GB); prefer methods with public code
